data.name: Kshivansh
data.gender_notes: Kshivansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kshivansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: Kshi (time) and Ansh (sign or symbol). The name thus means 'Lord of Time' or 'Auspicious'. The name Kshivansh carries the meaning “Lord of Time or Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kshivansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of time or auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of time and the belief that everything happens as per the divine plan.
data.etymology: Kshivansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Time or Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kshivansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kshivansh is rich in Indian cultural history. It is a unique and powerful name often associated with wisdom, power, and a deep understanding of the passage of time. In Hindu mythology, time is personified as 'Kala Chakra' or the cosmic cycle of creation and destruction. Kshivansh is seen as someone who has the power to navigate this cycle wisely and effectively- be it in matters of life, career, or relationships. It is a name that evokes respect and awe, particularly amongst the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Kshivansh holds immense significance. It signifies the belief that the Lord of Time (Kala) governs all aspects of life, and one who understands this truth is closer to enlightenment. Kshivansh is also seen as a symbol of the eternal cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, reminding us of the transient nature of life and the importance of living each day wisely and with purpose. Ultimately, the name Kshivansh is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of living in harmony with the natural flow of time.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kshivansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kshivi' meaning fear or anxiety, and 'Ansh' signifying essence or soul. Hence, Kshivansh represents the triumph of the soul over fear or anxiety, symbolizing courage, inner strength, and peace.

historical_references.reference: The Kshivasharma dynasty ruled over the Jaisalmer state in Rajasthan from the 11th to the 16th century. The name 'Kshivansh' is believed to be derived from this dynasty name, meaning 'descendants of Kshiv'.
The epic Mahabharata mentions a king named Kshivashwa, who was a descendant of the Yadava dynasty and ruled over the kingdom of Mathura in the 3rd century BCE.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kshivansh' is of Hindu origin and translates to 'shield of the god Shiva'. In modern contexts, this name can be seen in various spheres, including Bollywood movies where it is given to characters as a symbol of power and protection. It is also a popular choice among the Indian diaspora, particularly in the tech industry, where individuals with this name hold significant positions and make headlines. Social media platforms like IMDb, LinkedIn, and Twitter serve as modern avenues for showcasing the prominence of the name, with users using it as a search term to discover more information.
